results.name: WP-20 oracle: computed dynamic import() — root-relative in the document AND in a module worker (where no import map applies), a colon in the first path segment (document and worker), an absolute CROSS-ORIGIN URL object (document and worker; CSP refuses the raw URL), new URL("./x", import.meta.url), a template, a relative computed path in the worker, a bare name routed by the page's map, a missing module (same rejection), a classic inline script's computed import, and an eval'd import() routed only by an import-map SCOPE — every value IDENTICAL natively and through the proxy

WP-21 browsers WITHOUT Fetch Metadata (TT41 blocker; emulated at the HTTP layer: real Chromium behind a front that removes every Sec-Fetch-* header, as Safari < 16.4 sends none): the destination is inferred from the URL tag + Accept — module scripts and module workers are still rewritten (all computed / static imports identical to native), a page fetch() of a module still gets its bytes UNCHANGED (the shim's "e" flag = destination empty), and a page fetch() of a document gets NO navigation secret (before TT42 every untagged request without Fetch Metadata counted as a navigation)

WP-19 srcdoc frames (TT41 blocker): a STATIC srcdoc (server-rewritten: its image, its script's fetch, its inline MODULE's root-relative import, and a NESTED srcdoc's image) and DYNAMIC srcdoc set by script through the property and through setAttribute (shim-rewritten in an inert DOMParser document, runtime injected) — every resource reaches the site and every value the frames report to their parent is IDENTICAL natively and through the proxy
